economics.basis: This is what one destination costs to RUN at list price, not what was spent building the prototype. Actual out-of-pocket for the entire build was about GBP 0.82, because Google's free monthly allowance absorbed the Places calls and Anthropic introductory pricing was in force. Neither subsidy survives contact with 200 destinations, so neither is used below.

assumptions.name: Manual research time per destination
assumptions.source: Recorded assumption, not measured. Confirmed with the hiring team as a working figure.

assumptions.name: Model pricing
assumptions.value: Claude Sonnet 5 at standard rates, not the introductory rate expiring 31 August 2026
assumptions.source: Deliberately conservative. Actual spend was lower.

assumptions.name: Free tiers
assumptions.source: Google's first 1,000 Enterprise search calls each month are free, so the real Google bill for this build was GBP 0.00. Amortising an allowance that one destination exhausts would not scale.

assumptions.name: Enrichment cost
assumptions.value: Extrapolated: USD 0.01176 per operator x 167 operators
assumptions.source: Measured over a 40-operator sample and scaled. A production run enriches every operator; the 40 was a budget decision, not a design one.

assumptions.name: Places call count
assumptions.source: Recorded from the 14 august sweep, before metrics were persisted.
